title: DBYR shared definitions
description: Shared types. The non-standard keyword x-tier marks the disclosure tier of a field (public | restricted | sealed). It is an annotation: validators ignore it, and dbyr.redact uses it to project views. A field with no x-tier is a public container whose children carry their own tiers.

role_ref.description: Reference to a role_id declared in the Intent's roles[].

role_id.description: The signing role, declared in the roles of the Intent, or of the SystemRuntimeRecord for a deployed system.

organisation.description: The organisation the signer acts for.

end.description: null means open-ended: a rolling training run, or a system that stays deployed. Closeouts are then due every 30 days.

evidence_class.description: trajectories: full agent transcripts; chain_of_thought: reasoning traces; tool_calls: every tool invocation with arguments; network_logs: network flows leaving the sandbox; access_logs: authentication and authorisation records on reachable systems; inter_agent_messages: every write to a surface another agent can read, with author; config_snapshots: environment, permission and surface state at each change.

event_kind.description: environment_tampering: an agent alters its task, grader, reward or shared build/test inputs. access_boundary_breach: an agent reads or moves data outside the scope declared in readable_sources. data_exposure: restricted data reaches a wider audience than permitted. integrity_incident: unrequested bulk changes, propagated factual errors, or actions misattributed to a human.

safeguard.description: model_output_filters: production classifiers on outputs; refusal_behaviour: trained refusals; per_episode_reset: sandbox state wiped between episodes; network_isolation: no route to systems outside the declared paths; identity_separation: agents act under their own identity, never a human's; least_privilege_access: agents can read only what the task needs; cot_monitoring: the production chain-of-thought monitor runs on agent reasoning (optional item).

state.description: relaxed: weakened in any way from the production configuration.

change.description: What was changed, required unless state is on.
